passages.title: Bistro Lumière — Grand Opening Special
passages.content:
Bistro Lumière, the city's newest French restaurant, will open its doors on Saturday, May 4. To celebrate, we are offering a Grand Opening Special: a three-course tasting menu for $35 per person (regular price $55), available throughout May.

Our menu features classic French dishes prepared with locally-sourced ingredients. Reservations are highly recommended, especially for weekend dinners. Group bookings of 6 or more receive a complimentary dessert platter.

Located at 12 Maple Street, easily accessible from Central Station. Open Tuesday-Sunday, 5:30 PM - 10:30 PM.

passages.title: Customer Review — Bistro Lumière
passages.content:
★★★★☆

Tried the Grand Opening Special with my wife last Saturday for our anniversary. The duck confit was excellent and the chocolate soufflé melted in the mouth. Service was attentive and our waiter knew the menu inside out.

My only complaint: the place was packed, and we had to wait 15 minutes despite our reservation. The noise level was also higher than I prefer for a romantic dinner.

Still, at $35 for three courses of this quality, it's a steal. We'll definitely return — though probably on a quieter weekday.

questions.explanation: 広告 A に「regular price $55」と明記。

questions.explanation: 「Group bookings of 6 or more receive a complimentary dessert platter」と一致。

questions.q: What did the reviewer like most?
choices: The duck confit and chocolate soufflé
questions.explanation: 「duck confit was excellent and the chocolate soufflé melted in the mouth」と評価。

questions.q: What was the reviewer's main complaint?
questions.explanation: 「the place was packed... noise level was also higher」と一致。

questions.q: Based on both passages, how much did the reviewer's couple likely pay for the food?
questions.explanation: Grand Opening Special $35 × 2 名 = $70。アニバーサリーで二人で来店との情報から計算。

Subject: Modification request — Reservation GO-2024-08172
Date: August 14

Dear Reservations Team,

I hope this finds you well. Due to a delayed business meeting, my flight has been pushed back, and I will not arrive until late evening on Friday, August 16. Could you please:

1. Hold my reservation for late check-in (around 10 PM)?
2. Add an additional night (extending my stay through Monday, August 19)?

If the additional night is unavailable, please let me know as soon as possible. I would prefer to confirm before my flight tomorrow.

Thank you,
James Walker

questions.q: What type of room did Mr. Walker book?
questions.explanation: 確認書に「Deluxe Ocean View」と明記。

questions.q: What is included in the reservation?
questions.explanation: 「Complimentary breakfast for two」と一致。

questions.q: Why is Mr. Walker writing the email?
questions.explanation: 件名「Modification request」と本文の依頼内容より。

questions.q: What is the cancellation policy?
choices: No charge if cancelled at any time
One-night charge if cancelled within 48 hours
questions.explanation: 「Cancellations made within 48 hours will incur a one-night charge」と一致。

questions.q: Based on both passages, when does Mr. Walker now want to check out?
questions.explanation: メールで「extending my stay through Monday, August 19」と希望。

passages.title: Email Invitation
passages.content:
From: events@asiatech-summit.com
To: M. Thompson
Subject: Asia Tech Summit 2024 — Speaker Invitation
Date: June 3

Dear Ms. Thompson,

We are delighted to invite you as a keynote speaker at the Asia Tech Summit 2024, taking place from October 14-16 in Singapore. Your work on AI-driven supply chain optimization aligns perfectly with this year's theme: 'Intelligent Operations.'

We would be honored if you could deliver the opening keynote on Day 1. Travel and accommodation will be fully covered. Please confirm your participation by July 1.

Warm regards,
Elaine Cho, Conference Director

passages.title: Reply from M. Thompson
passages.content:
From: m.thompson@logistic-ai.com
To: events@asiatech-summit.com
Subject: Re: Asia Tech Summit 2024 — Speaker Invitation
Date: June 18

Dear Elaine,

Thank you for the kind invitation. I am honored and would gladly accept, with one small request: I have a board meeting on the morning of October 14 in Tokyo and may not be able to arrive before noon Singapore time.

Would it be possible to switch the timing of my keynote to the closing slot? If Dr. Watanabe is willing to swap, I'd be very grateful. If not, I am happy to participate in the panel discussion instead.

Looking forward to your reply,
Margaret

questions.explanation: 「'Intelligent Operations'」と明記。

questions.q: What was Ms. Thompson originally invited to do?
questions.explanation: 「opening keynote on Day 1」と一致。

questions.q: What is the deadline for confirming participation?
questions.explanation: 「Please confirm your participation by July 1」と一致。

questions.q: Why does Ms. Thompson ask to swap her keynote slot?
choices: She prefers to speak in the afternoon
She has a board meeting that morning
questions.explanation: 「I have a board meeting on the morning of October 14 in Tokyo」と一致。

questions.q: Based on all three passages, who currently has the closing keynote slot?
questions.explanation: アジェンダに「Closing Keynote: Dr. Kenji Watanabe」と明記。Margaret はその枠との交換を提案。

passages.title: Job Posting
passages.content:
POSITION: Senior Data Scientist — Healthcare AI
Company: NovaMed Analytics
Location: Hybrid (Boston HQ, 2 days remote)

We are seeking an experienced data scientist to lead AI initiatives in clinical decision support. The successful candidate will:
- Design and deploy ML models for hospital workflows
- Collaborate with clinicians and product teams
- Mentor 3-4 junior data scientists

Required:
- PhD in CS, Statistics, or related field
- 5+ years industry experience, ideally in healthcare
- Proficiency in Python, R, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)

Compensation: $185K-$220K base, plus equity. Apply by August 15.

passages.title: Applicant CV Excerpt
passages.content:
Dr. Rachel Nguyen — CV Highlights

EDUCATION:
• PhD, Biostatistics, Stanford University, 2017

EXPERIENCE:
• Senior Data Scientist, MedTech Innovations (2020-present, 4 years)
  — Led ML model development for diagnostic imaging
  — Managed team of 2 junior scientists

• Data Scientist, BiotechCo (2017-2020, 3 years)
  — Built predictive models for clinical trials

TECHNICAL SKILLS:
• Python, R, SQL — expert
• AWS (5 years), GCP (2 years)
• Deep learning frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch

passages.title: Hiring Manager's Note
passages.content:
Internal note from David Chen, Hiring Manager — August 18

Reviewed Rachel Nguyen's application this morning. Strong technical background and her PhD/AWS experience are excellent fits.

Concern: She has 7 years total experience, but only 4 years post-PhD as a senior IC, which is on the lower end of our requirement. However, her domain depth in clinical imaging is impressive.

Recommend: Move forward to phone screen. Probe specifically on (1) leading larger teams (we expect her to mentor 3-4 vs. her current 2), and (2) experience with regulatory compliance (HIPAA, FDA).

Next step: Schedule 30-minute phone screen with technical lead by August 25.

questions.explanation: 求人票に「$185K-$220K base」と明記。

questions.explanation: 「Mentor 3-4 junior data scientists」と一致。

questions.q: How long has Dr. Nguyen worked at MedTech Innovations?
questions.explanation: 「2020-present, 4 years」と一致。

questions.q: What is the hiring manager's main concern about Dr. Nguyen?
questions.explanation: 「Probe specifically on (1) leading larger teams」と一致。

questions.explanation: 「7 years total experience」とノートに記載。CV では 4+3=7年が確認できる。
